title: Towards Robust and Fair Next Visit Diagnosis Prediction under Noisy Clinical Notes with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing predictive performance (Recall, Precision) and fairness metrics (True Positive Rate, False Positive Rate) for next-visit diagnosis prediction across racial subgroups (e.g., White, Black, Hispanic/Latino, Asian) under clean and simulated noisy clinical text conditions.
Comparing diagnostic prediction accuracy and error rate disparities (TPR, FPR) across different patient age groups (18-40, 41-60, 61+) using both original and degraded clinical notes.
Evaluating stability and parity in predictive performance and fairness metrics (Recall, Precision, TPR, FPR) between male and female patient records subjected to various text perturbation scenarios.
